summary: Emily, 29, died in a fall of roughly 100-150 ft from the Catwalk, the exposed ridge joining North Eolus to Mt. Eolus; her body slid another ~400 ft and was recovered at 37.62213/-107.61904; she was climbing solo
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue
notes: 2026-09-15: 14ers.com forum link removed per site ban; replaced with La Plata County Sheriff Office public Facebook post (published 2026-06-30) stating SO notified 6/25/23 ~07:47 of deceased female hiker in Chicago Basin, likely fell from the Catwalk; recovery by La Plata County SAR (inserted by Flight for Life Lifeguard 5) with San Juan Mountain Rescue and Canon City Helitack assisting. Date corrected 2023-07-01 -> 2023-06-25 per official notification; wx re-pinned to corrected date. Victim died within seconds from a head injury per her brother.
